ns2:section.sectionText: Not intended for students in the human nutrition concentration. This course covers the importance of diet to achieve optimal nutrition; the role of various types physical activities to achieve fitness; and ways to manage stress and adopt other health-promoting behaviors so as to maximize wellness throughout each stage of adulthood. First Year Discovery Program Course. Registration restricted to freshmen. Students should enroll in only one Discovery course.
ns2:section.sectionCappArea: Restricted to First Time Freshman students.
